newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-PORTO SNATCH LAST-MINUTE WINNER IN NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO SNATCH LAST-MINUTE WINNER IN NORWAY.

text.p: Porto kept up their unbeaten run in the European Champion's League Cup on Wednesday thanks to a last-minute winner from Brazilian substitute Mario Jardel against Norway's Rosenborg.
Jardel slotted home a headed pass from compatriot Edmilson from a corner in the 90th minute, keeping Porto on top of Group D with three wins from three games.

The Portuguese club dominated the goalless first half but went off the boil in the second until Rosenborg paid the price for the sending-off of striker Jahn Ivar Jakobsen in the 75th minute. He received a second yellow card for protesting to the referee.
Porto's best chance in the first-half came after 10 minutes when Rosenborg goalkeeper Jorn Jamtfall kept out a close-range header from Edmilson.

Steffen Iversen, Jahn Ivar Jakobsen and Bent Skammerlsrud all came close in for the home side in the second-half and goalkeeper Hilario kept Porto afloat a minute later when he blocked a powerful shot from midfielder Trond Soltvedt.

Rosenborg - 1-Jorn Jamtfall, 14-Vegard Heggem, 18-Bjoern Kvarme, 3-Erik Hoftun, 5-Staale Stensaas (7-Tom Kaare Staurvik 83rd), 6-Roar Strand, 8-Bent Skammerlsrud, 20-Trond Soltvedt, 11-Jahn Ivar Jakobsen, 16-Steffen Iversen, 10-Harald Brattbakk.
